cases.description: Standard case with MD5 algorithm and a typical domain name. Expected length = name(13) + alg(26) + mac(16) + constant(32) = 87.
Shortest possible domain name (single‑character label) with SHA‑256 algorithm. Expected length = name(3) + alg(13) + mac(32) + 32 = 80.
Domain name with three labels and an algorithm that truncates the MAC to 128‑bit (16 bytes). Expected length = name(28) + alg(17) + mac(16) + 32 = 93.
GSS‑TSIG algorithm which is mapped to a MAC length of 0 bytes. Expected length = name(13) + alg(10) + mac(0) + 32 = 55.
Maximum‑size DNS name (255 bytes in wire format) with SHA‑1 algorithm (20‑byte MAC). Expected length = name(255) + alg(11) + mac(20) + 32 = 318.
Passing a null Name should cause a NullPointerException because recordLength dereferences name.length().
Passing a null algorithm Name should cause a NullPointerException because recordLength dereferences alg.length() and algLengthMap.get(alg).
Algorithm Name not present in algLengthMap should cause NullPointerException due to autounboxing of a null Integer returned by algLengthMap.get(alg).
